title: Check approved routes for the NSW Livestock Loading Scheme
summary: This page helps heavy vehicle operators under the NSW Livestock Loading Scheme plan their routes using an interactive online map.

faqs.q: What is the NSW Livestock Loading Scheme (NSWLLS)?
faqs.a: The NSW Livestock Loading Scheme (NSWLLS) is a program for heavy vehicles operating in NSW.

faqs.q: How can I check approved routes?
faqs.a: You can use an interactive online map to plan your route in NSW and check the approved routes for vehicles enrolled in the NSWLLS.
Approved routes are the legally enforceable network in NSW.
